instances.emptyHint: Add a MySQL or MariaDB server to start managing its backups.
instances.hostHint: Inside the panel's container, “localhost” is the panel itself. For a server on the host machine use host.docker.internal; for a server in another container on a shared network use its container name.

instances.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? Its database selection will also be removed. This cannot be undone.

connection.title: Connection
connection.passwordNeeded: Enter the password to test changed connection settings.

explain.host_not_found: The host name could not be resolved. Check the spelling, or use host.docker.internal or a container name if the panel runs in a container.
explain.connection_refused: The host was reached but nothing accepted the connection on this port. Check the port and that the server is running and listening on the network.

backups.title: Backups
backups.nothingMarked: Mark databases for backup in the list below to enable this.
backups.skipped: “{{database}}” skipped: a backup of it is already in progress.

explain.missing_privileges: The database user lacks a privilege needed for the backup. Grant SELECT, SHOW VIEW, TRIGGER, EVENT and LOCK TABLES to this user (see README).
explain.database_not_found: The database does not exist on the server. It may have been dropped or renamed. Uncheck it in the database list.
explain.connection_lost: The connection to the server was lost during the backup. Check that the server is running and reachable, then try again.
explain.dump_failed: The dump tool reported an error. See the details below for the server's message.
explain.disk_full: Not enough disk space for the backup. Free up space in the backup storage area or delete old backups.
explain.verification_failed: The backup file failed verification and was deleted. The dump was incomplete or the file is damaged. Try again; if it repeats, check the details.
explain.interrupted: The backup was interrupted because the panel stopped or restarted. Start the backup again.
explain.instance_deleted: The instance was deleted before the backup started. Nothing to do; the run is kept for the record.
explain.tool_missing: The dump tool is not installed in the panel. Rebuild the backend image; it includes mysqldump and mariadb-dump.
explain.storage_error: The backup file could not be written to the storage area. Check the storage directory setting and the volume permissions.
explain.invalid_database_name: The database name starts with “-” or contains control characters, so it cannot be passed to the dump tool safely. Rename the database or remove it from the selection.

backups.removedByRetention: Local file removed by retention on {{date}}
backups.removedManually: Local file deleted on {{date}}; the remote copy was kept

settings.title: Backup settings
settings.globalHint: Defaults for all instances. Each instance can override them on its page.
settings.instanceHint: Unchecked fields use the global setting.
settings.storageDirHelp: Relative to the backup volume. Leave empty for its root.
settings.namePatternHelp: Use / for subfolders. The extension is added automatically. Times are in UTC.

validation.absolute_path: Use a relative path inside the backup storage area.
validation.empty_segment: Empty path parts ("//" or a trailing "/") are not allowed.
validation.invalid_character: Contains characters that are not allowed.

schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.hint: Backups run automatically at these times. A schedule backs up all marked databases of its instance, or one database.
schedules.deleteConfirm: Delete the schedule “{{name}}”? Existing backups are kept.

validation.invalid_cron: Enter a valid 5-field cron expression, e.g. 0 2 * * *.
validation.not_selectable: System schemas cannot be backed up.
validation.invalid_database_name: This database name is not allowed.

remote.title: Remote storage (S3-compatible)
remote.hint: Backups are uploaded after they are verified. Works with AWS S3 and S3-compatible services such as MinIO, RustFS, Ceph, Wasabi or ArvanCloud.
remote.enabledHelp: The default for all instances. Each instance can turn it on or off on its page.
remote.secretStored: A secret is stored. Leave empty to keep it.
remote.pathStyleHelp: Required by most self-hosted services (MinIO, RustFS, Ceph).
remote.testOk: Connected. The bucket is readable and writable.

retention.title: Retention
retention.hint: Old backups are deleted automatically, per database, after each backup and every hour. The newest backup of each database is always kept. Empty fields mean no limit.
retention.maxAgeHelp: Backups older than this are deleted.
retention.previewHint: These files would be deleted under the saved policy:
retention.nothingToDelete: Nothing to delete under the saved policy.
retention.remoteMaxAgeHelp: At least 7: remote copies are always kept for 7 days after upload, whatever the policy.

policy.title: Remote upload and retention
policy.overrideRetention: Use a retention policy for this instance
policy.inheritRetention: Unchecked: the global retention policy applies.

bots.title: Bots (Bale and Telegram)
bots.hint: Manage backups from a chat with inline buttons: status, servers, start backups, history, schedules and retention. Only the admins registered below can use a bot; anyone else only sees their own numeric ID. Bots connect out to the messenger (long polling), so the panel needs no public address.

howTo.bale: In Bale, open @botfather, create a bot and paste its token here.
howTo.telegram: In Telegram, open @BotFather, create a bot with /newbot and paste its token here. If Telegram is blocked on the server, set a proxy under Advanced.

bots.tokenStored: A token is stored. Leave empty to keep it.
bots.allowFiles: Allow downloading backup files through the bot
bots.allowFilesHelp: Sends database contents to the messenger's servers. Leave off unless you accept that.
bots.proxyHelp: http://, https:// or socks5:// without a username or password.
bots.apiBaseHelp: Leave empty for the official API.

testErrors.unreachable: The messenger could not be reached (check the network or proxy).
testErrors.timeout: The messenger did not answer in time.
testErrors.bad_response: The messenger sent an unexpected answer.

validation.invalid_proxy: Use http://, https:// or socks5://host:port without credentials.

admins.title: Bot admins
admins.hint: Each person needs their numeric user ID on that messenger. They see it by sending any message to the bot, or you can give them a one-time link code.
admins.userIdHelp: Shown by the bot to unregistered users.
admins.name: Name
admins.deleteConfirm: Remove “{{name}}”? They can no longer use the bot or receive alerts.

link.title: Link code
link.hint: A one-time code, valid for 15 minutes. Whoever sends it to the bot becomes an admin with this name.
link.instructions: Send this code to the bot:
link.step1: Open the bot in the messenger.
link.step2: Send the code as a message (or /start followed by the code).

alerts.title: Notifications and alerts
alerts.hint: Choose which events raise an alert and where it goes. Every alert is kept in the history below, with where it was delivered.

rules.title: Alert rules
rules.hint: Bot admins also choose their own level (e.g. errors only) on the Bots page or in the bot.
rules.botNote: Bale and Telegram alerts go to bot admins:

descriptions.backup_failed: A backup ended with an error.
descriptions.upload_failed: A backup could not be uploaded to remote storage.
descriptions.stale_backup: A marked database has had no successful backup for longer than the limit below.
descriptions.disk_low: Free space in the backup area is below the limit below.
descriptions.schedule_problem: A schedule fired but could not start, e.g. no databases are marked.
descriptions.retention_error: An old remote copy could not be deleted.
descriptions.backup_succeeded: Every successful backup (can be a lot of messages).
descriptions.recovered: A stale backup or low disk space alert has cleared.
descriptions.daily_summary: A report of the last 24 hours, at the time below.

thresholds.title: Thresholds and timing
thresholds.stale: Alert when a database has no successful backup for (hours)
thresholds.staleHelp: Set it a little above your schedule's interval, e.g. 26 for daily backups.
thresholds.disk: Alert when free disk space is below (%)
thresholds.diskHelp: Below half of this, the alert becomes an error.
thresholds.cooldown: Repeat the same alert at most every (minutes)
thresholds.cooldownHelp: Repeats within this time are recorded but not sent. 0 sends every one.
thresholds.timezoneHelp: For the daily summary and for times in bot messages.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.hint: Each alert is POSTed as JSON (event, severity, message, params). With a secret, the X-MBP-Signature header carries sha256=HMAC-SHA256 of the body. Works with n8n, Slack/Mattermost bridges and similar tools.
webhook.secretStored: A secret is stored. Leave empty to keep it.

test.button: Send a test alert to all channels

history.title: Alert history
history.suppressedHelp: The same alert was sent recently; see the cooldown setting.

account.title: Account security
account.subtitle: Signed in as {{name}}
account.twoFactorHint: After your password, sign-in also asks for a 6-digit code from an authenticator app on your phone. A stolen password alone is then not enough.
account.step1: Install Google Authenticator (or Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis, 2FAS…) on your phone.
account.step2: In the app, add an account and scan this QR code.
account.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
account.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
account.manualKey: Or enter this key by hand
account.codesHint: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. They are shown only now; store them somewhere safe, away from your phone.
account.codesLow: Few recovery codes are left. Create new ones.
account.regenerateHint: The old recovery codes stop working. Confirm with your password and a current code.
account.disableHint: Sign-in will need only your password again. Confirm with your password and a current code (or a recovery code).
account.deviceHint: Shows the current key again, so another phone or app shows the same codes. Codes already set up keep working. Confirm with your password and a current code.
account.deviceCheck: Check that the new device shows the same code as your other devices.
